svg.text: Same derivation template adapts to coprime (13, 8) and zero edge cases
Dependent type Gcd(a, b) is a family of sets indexed by (a, b); the proof skeleton stays identical
Dependent Type Family: (a, b : ℕ) ↦ Inv(a,b) = {(x,y) | Div(x)∩Div(y) = Div(a)∩Div(b)} ──► Gcd(a,b) = {g | Div(g) = Div(a)∩Div(b)}
Case A: Coprime Inputs (a = 13, b = 8) → gcd = 1 (5 loop iterations: Fibonacci worst-case)
Case B: Zero Input Edge Case (a = 21, b = 0) → gcd = 21 (0 loop steps: immediate exit)
Case C: Double-Zero Singularity (a = 0, b = 0) → gcd = 0 (only number divisible by all of ℕ)
